title: Fire and gas
summary: Design rationale for per-tile fields: the TileField double-buffer step, gas as registry content, fire as engine rules, their integration, placement and exclusions.
notes: Subsystem design doc under docs/design/ (the repo's 'how one subsystem works, and why' folder). Prose-heavy rationale with no ADR status/Decision/Consequences sections, no user stories, and no formal schema or endpoint tables, so DOC. It does state firm engine behaviour (double-buffer stepping, required TileProps::burn leaves, seed-hashed fire rolls, ResolveSet::Fields ordering with fire before gas, opt-in plugins) that could read as SPEC-like constraints; the synthesizer may want to weigh these above plain context. Cross-ref 'docs/PLAN.md' is cited as 'Plan section 3.9', not a literal path. Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of the SHA-256 hash because no shell was available to compute it.
